info.title: FinSpace Public API

requests.description: Adds a user account to a permission group to grant permissions for actions a user can perform in FinSpace.
requests.name: POST /permission-group/{permissionGroupId}/users/{userId}
requests.note: Replace {{FINSPACE_PUBLIC_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a user account from a permission group.
requests.name: DELETE /permission-group/{permissionGroupId}/users/{userId}
requests.note: Replace {{FINSPACE_PUBLIC_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns the credentials to access the external Dataview from an S3 location. To call this API:

  • You must retrieve the programmatic credentials.

  • You must be a member of a FinSpace user group, where the dataset that you want to access has Read Dataset Data permissions.
requests.name: POST /datasets/{datasetId}/dataviewsv2/{dataviewId}/external-access-details
requests.note: Replace {{FINSPACE_PUBLIC_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
